title: Digital Advertising Company System1 Gets SPAC Deal With Bill Foley: What Investors Should Know
description:
A leading omnichannel customer acquisition platform announced a SPAC deal Tuesday with a well-known SPAC sponsor.
The SPAC Deal: System1 announced a SPAC merger with Trebia Acquisition Corp (NYSE: TREB). The SPAC is one of several launched by Bill Foley, who will join the board of directors upon closing of the merger.
The deal values System1 at an enterprise value of $1.4 billion.
Financing of $600 million for the SPAC merger includes an investment from Cannae Holdings Inc (NYSE: CNNE).
The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2021 with System1 trading under the ticker "SST" on the NYSE.
